business.summary: State-controlled refiner and fuel marketer (Maharatna CPSE; ONGC owns 54.90%). Two own refineries (Mumbai 9.5 MMTPA, Visakhapatnam 15 MMTPA after the VRMP expansion) processed a record 26.04 MMT in FY26 (106.3% utilisation), but HPCL sold 51.45 MMT: it buys about half of what it sells from joint-venture refineries (HMEL Bathinda 11.3 MMTPA, MRPL 15 MMTPA, and from Jul-2026 HRRL Barmer 9 MMTPA) and third parties. That makes it the most marketing-heavy of the three state oil marketing companies.
business.segments: One reportable segment (downstream petroleum: refining and marketing); 'all other' (E&P via Prize Petroleum, sugar/ethanol via HPCL Biofuels) had revenue of ₹475 cr and an EBIT loss of ₹241 cr in FY26 (ar26 consolidated note 60).

investments._note: Consolidated, Mar-26 (ar26 notes 6, 7, 12, 61). Screener 'Investments' ₹28,012 cr = equity-accounted ₹22,897 cr + other non-current ₹2,008 cr + G-secs ₹3,107 cr.

hrrl.capacity: 9 MMTPA refinery with 2.4 MMTPA petrochemicals (26% petchem intensity)
hrrl.cod: Scheduled commercial operation declared 22-Jun-2026 (MOSL, sahi); dedicated to the nation 4-Jul-2026 (ar26); PL reports commercial operations from 4-Jul.
hrrl.rampUp: ~50-60% in Q2FY27, 80-85% in Q3FY27, full refinery capacity in Q4FY27; petrochemicals by end-FY27 (Q1 call via PL, Emkay)
hrrl.src: ar26 notes 1.3.6, 6, 49 (sub-debt); ccea; pl; emkay; mosl

standalone.grmNote: pre-SAED (export duty); GRM US$14.3/bbl in Q4FY26 (PL; BOB says 14.5) and US$3.1 in Q1FY26

call.underRecovery: Marketing under-recoveries above ₹26,000 cr in Q1FY27: ~₹20,000 cr on petrol and diesel, the rest on domestic LPG. LPG under-recovery ₹510/cylinder on average in Q1, ₹680 in June, ~₹490 in July; July 'materially better'.
call.lpgBuffer: Negative LPG buffer ₹16,410 cr at 30-Jun-2026 (₹12,799 cr at 31-Mar-2026), after ₹1,980 cr of compensation received in Q1. MoPNG conveyed ₹7,920 cr of compensation in Oct-2025, accrued in 12 monthly instalments from Nov-2025 (₹3,300 cr in FY26).
call.inventory: HPCL deliberately carried more crude than usual to keep the refineries running, and took inventory write-downs in Q1; without them the loss would have been 'well below a five-digit crore' figure.
call.crude: Crude bought mostly spot; requirements tied up to August, September under way; availability no longer a concern, prices volatile. LPG harder to diversify (historically via the Strait of Hormuz).
call.hrrl: HRRL commercial operations from end-June/4-Jul; CDU at ~60%, 80-85% in Q3FY27, full in Q4FY27; petrochemicals by end-FY27.
call.rug: Vizag Residue Upgradation Facility (3.55 MMTPA LC-Max, commissioned Dec-2025/Jan-2026) not yet stable in Q1 (high pressure/temperature and catalyst issues); stabilisation expected Q2-Q3FY27; BOB expects +US$2.5/bbl on Vizag's GRM once stable.
call.sourcing: Petrol/diesel sourcing in Q1: 50% own refineries, 27% JV refineries, 24% third parties; next year ~56% own (with RUF), ~40% JVs (mainly HRRL), only a small balance from third parties; no third-party diesel needed.
call.capex: FY27 capex ₹9,700 cr (cap agreed with the Government), likely lower; Q1 ₹1,734 cr (mostly refinery maintenance).
call.samriddhi: Samriddhi 1.0 added ₹1,691 cr of EBITDA in FY26; Samriddhi 2.0 targets ₹1,500 cr run-rate savings, ~₹1,000 cr in FY27.
call.balanceSheet: Priority: lower leverage, conserve cash, cut interest cost. Gross debt ₹72,600 cr at Jun-26 (₹47,600 cr at Mar-26); standalone debt/equity ~1.43-1.5x.

corporateActions: ONGC buys the Government's controlling stake for ₹36,915 cr; HPCL becomes an ONGC subsidiary
Controlling holder is another state company; stake 54.90% after later buybacks
Open-market share buybacks (one of up to ₹2,500 cr at ≤₹250 a share; ₹966 cr spent in FY22)
Ukraine war: retail prices held while crude spiked
Shares 141.85 cr → 212.78 cr; Screener EPS restated
MoPNG conveys ₹7,920 cr LPG compensation, paid monthly from Nov-2025
Vizag Residue Upgradation Facility (3.55 MMTPA) commissioned
Nelson complexity 11.6; GRM uplift once stable
Independent directors' terms end; one left on an 8-member board
Board and Audit Committee out of compliance with SEBI LODR
Cabinet approves HRRL cost of ₹79,459 cr (from ₹43,129 cr); HPCL equity commitment ₹19,600 cr
US-Iran war; Hormuz disrupted; retail prices held
HRRL (9 MMTPA, Barmer) starts commercial operation
Equity-accounted JV; ramp to full capacity in Q4FY27

governance.board: 8 directors: 5 whole-time (CMD Vikas Kaushal from 17-Mar-2025; Directors Refineries S. Bharathan, Marketing Amit Garg, HR K S Shetty, Finance Srividya Venkataraman from 24-Jun-2026), 2 Government nominees (MoPNG's Alok Tripathi; ONGC's Vikram Saxena) and 1 independent director (Abhay Sharma, from 9-May-2025).
governance.independence: Two independent directors' one-year terms ended on 27-Mar-2026 and a third on 4-May-2026; the Secretarial report flags that the board lacked the required independent directors and a properly constituted Audit Committee. Appointments rest with the Government.
governance.auditCag: Statutory auditors appointed by the C&AG; 14 pending C&AG paras at Mar-26 (leave encashment, idle storage investment, purchases from private oil companies, etc.).
governance.cfoChange: Director (Finance) Rajneesh Narang retired 31-May-2026; Srividya Venkataraman (ex-BPCL treasury) CFO from 7-Jul-2026.
